title: Schedule of Benefit Limits for Home Protection Plans
content:
This schedule sets the dollar limits on what each Home Protection Plan pays for covered work, what it pays for, and how amounts above a limit and payout cents are handled.

## A. Dollar limits (USD)

| Plan | Annual coverage cap (most paid for covered repairs in one plan year) | Per-claim cap (most paid for one repair) | Code-upgrade cap (permits and code upgrades a covered repair requires) | Surge electronics cap (per plan year, electronics damaged by a power surge) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $0.00 | $1000.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | $3000.00 | $3000.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | $3000.00 | $3000.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | $2500.00 | $1500.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | $3500.00 | $2000.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | $6000.00 | $4500.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | $10000.00 | $4500.00 | $500.00 | $1000.00 |

## B. Replacement of an unrepairable covered unit

| Plan | Unrepairable covered unit replaced | Replacement cap (most paid toward a replacement unit, within the annual coverage cap) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | No | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | No | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | No | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | No | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | No | $0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | Yes | $4500.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | Yes | $4500.00 |

## C. Terms common to every plan

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Parts covered | Yes |
| Labor covered | Yes |
| Repair costs above a cap | The customer pays the contractor directly |
| Rounding of payouts | Rounded half up to the nearest cent |

## Notes on the schedule

1. The replacement cap sits within the annual coverage cap: it limits the amount paid toward a replacement unit and does not add to the annual figure.
2. A cap of $0.00 means the plan pays nothing under that heading. Beacon Ridge Surge Shield, for example, pays no code-upgrade amount, and only Beacon Ridge Surge Shield and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield carry a surge electronics cap above $0.00.
